subject: SOC2: authorization telemetry & role-tally deliverables for StarliteHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@starlitehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: ciso@starlitehealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial ask: authorization telemetry + role inventory for SOC2 onboarding

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As part of our SOC 2 review we need a short set of deliverables to validate access controls for the workloads Redwood will serve. Can you provide the following for the period 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-01?

- A sample of SAML assertion logs (time, issuer, subject, audience, assertion ID) — redacted for PII if necessary.
- SCIM delta export showing user create/update/delete events and the actor/service that triggered them.
- Role-to-permissions mapping (CSV preferred) and the canonical role IDs used in your RBAC.
- A list of active service accounts and whether any have privileged roles.

If you can send a scoped snapshot and a short note on how you enforce least-privilege (role review cadence, automated revocation, ephemeral creds), that will cover our control owner questions. Ideally we’d get the artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-15).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call to clarify.

— Asha
IT Security, Starlite Health

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: authorization telemetry + role inventory for SOC2 onboarding

Asha —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a scoped set of artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-15). A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope exactly what you need:

1) Retention/redaction: do you want UPNs/employee emails replaced with stable pseudonyms (user_###) or fully redacted?
2) Role mapping format: CSV with columns [role_id, role_name, permissions_list] OK? We can also include JSON if you prefer.
3) For SCIM delta export, do you want raw 429/patch events or a time-ordered normalized CSV?

Marissa, Karthik — can you run the exports + draft a 1-paragraph controls note (least-privilege + review cadence + ephemeral key usage) and drop artifacts to a presigned S3 folder? I’ll coordinate transfer and a short sync with Asha.

Priya Natarajan
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 13:56:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: authorization telemetry + role inventory for SOC2 onboarding

Priya —

We’ll prepare the exports. Plan:
- Generate saml_assertions_preview.csv (first 5k assertion rows) with PII pseudonymization applied (user_xxx).
- Export scim_delta_2026-11-01_to_2026-12-01.csv in normalized form (timestamp, event_type, actor_id, target_id, attrs_changed).
- Produce role_to_permissions_export_20261215.csv (role_id, role_name, permission_ids, permission_descriptions).
- Produce service_accounts_snapshot.txt with last-used timestamps and assigned roles.

I’ll upload to a presigned S3 location and paste the link into the final message.
Estimated time: 6–8 hours (there are some cross-tenant queries to run).

— Marissa
Senior Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@starlitehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: ciso@starlitehealth.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: authorization telemetry + role inventory for SOC2 onboarding

Thanks — pseudonyms are great (user_###). CSV format is perfect. For SCIM, the normalized CSV works best. Two small asks: please include the canonical role IDs as referenced in your Console (we map by IDs) and redact any internal IP addresses from logs. Also, can you confirm whether any service accounts have console-level admin or org-level roles — a yes/no flag is fine.

If you can include a short controls statement (1–2 paragraphs) that we can attach to our evidence package, that will be helpful.

— Asha

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 15:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Deliverable: authorization exports + controls note (S3 link appended)

Asha —

Attached below are the artifacts we prepared per your request. Sensitive fields have been pseudonymized and internal IPs redacted. The S3 link is pre-signed for 14 days. If you need a longer retention window let us know and we can provide a secure transfer alternative.

S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference-secure/starlite/2026-12-15/authorization_exports_presigned
HUBSPOT: HUBSPOT-123456789

Attachments included in the package: saml_assertions_preview.csv, scim_delta_2026-11-01_to_2026-12-01.csv, role_to_permissions_export_20261215.csv, service_accounts_snapshot.txt

Controls note (excerpt):
Redwood enforces least-privilege through a combination of RBAC definitions (role canonicalization in the Console), quarterly role-owner attestations, automated SCIM-driven deprovisioning for terminated users, and ephemeral token issuance for short-lived workloads. Privileged roles are restricted to a small set of service accounts and human operators; we rotate machine credentials monthly and require multi-party approval for any role elevation. Event telemetry (SAML assertions and SCIM deltas) is retained for 90 days and available on request within our compliance review window.

Marissa ran the exports — pinged below for technical details if you want row counts or format notes.

Priya Natarajan
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
